name: Rice blast
symptoms: Spindle-shaped lesions with grey centre on leaves, nodes and panicle neck
differential_diagnosis: Brown spot (no spindle shape, nutrient stress) vs Bacterial leaf blight (water-soaked, no grey centre)
management: Resistant varieties, balanced N; tricyclazole/isoprothiolane at booting

name: Bacterial leaf blight
symptoms: Water-soaked lesions, yellowing, drying from leaf tip
differential_diagnosis: Bacterial leaf streak (narrow streaks, no ooze droplets) vs Rice blast
management: Clean seed, avoid excess N; copper sprays

name: Brown spot
symptoms: Brown oval spots on leaves and grains

name: Sheath blight
symptoms: Grey-green lesions on leaf sheaths near water line
differential_diagnosis: Sheath rot (panicle, dark) vs Stem rot (sclerotia at base)

name: Wheat rusts (leaf/stem/stripe)
symptoms: Rust-coloured pustules on leaves/stem
differential_diagnosis: Leaf rust (scattered orange pustules) vs Stem rust (elongated on stem) vs Stripe rust (yellow stripes along veins)

name: Powdery mildew
symptoms: White powdery growth on leaves
differential_diagnosis: Downy mildew (yellow patches, cool wet) vs Rusts

name: Downy mildew
symptoms: Chlorotic stripes, white downy growth, stunting
differential_diagnosis: Crazy top (distorted tassel) vs Nutrient deficiency

name: Banded leaf and sheath blight
symptoms: Banded lesions on leaf/sheath

name: Early blight
symptoms: Concentric ring spots on lower leaves
differential_diagnosis: Late blight (water-soaked greasy lesions, cool humid) vs Septoria (small spots with dark margin and pycnidia) vs Bacterial speck (pinhead spots, no rings)

name: Late blight
symptoms: Water-soaked greasy lesions, white growth under leaf
differential_diagnosis: Early blight (concentric rings, warm) vs Grey mould (fluffy grey growth) vs Bacterial spot

name: Bacterial wilt
symptoms: Sudden wilting, brown vascular browning
differential_diagnosis: Fusarium wilt (one-sided yellowing, cooler) vs Verticillium wilt vs Root-knot nematode damage
management: Crop rotation, resistant rootstocks, soil solarization

name: Leaf curl
symptoms: Upward curling, yellowing, stunting
differential_diagnosis: Herbicide damage (no whitefly, not contagious) vs Water stress vs Nutrient deficiency

name: Late blight
symptoms: Brown-black lesions on leaves and tubers
differential_diagnosis: Early blight (concentric rings) vs Black scurf

name: Anthracnose (die-back/fruit rot)
symptoms: Sunken dark spots on fruit, die-back of twigs
differential_diagnosis: Sunscald (no pathogen, white papery) vs Bacterial soft rot

name: Leaf curl
symptoms: Curling, puckering, stunting
differential_diagnosis: Thrips damage (silvery streaks) vs Herbicide injury vs Nutrient deficiency

name: Purple blotch
symptoms: Purple blotches on leaves, leaf die-back
differential_diagnosis: Downy mildew (grey-violet growth) vs Stemphylium blight (yellow spots, no purple)

name: Leaf curl
symptoms: Upward curling, enations on veins
differential_diagnosis: Nutritional disorder vs Whitefly injury vs Herbicide drift

name: Fusarium wilt
symptoms: Wilting, vascular discoloration
differential_diagnosis: Verticillium wilt (V-shaped lesions) vs Root rot

name: Red rot
symptoms: Reddening of internodes with white patches
differential_diagnosis: Smut (whip) vs Mosaic (viral, chlorotic patterns)
management: Resistant varieties, clean setts, hot water treatment

name: Smut
symptoms: Whip-like black sorus from apex
differential_diagnosis: Grassy shoot (phytoplasma, grassy tillers) vs Red rot

name: Tikka (early/late leaf spot)
symptoms: Circular brown spots, premature defoliation
differential_diagnosis: Rust (orange pustules on underside) vs Leaf miner damage

name: Downy mildew
symptoms: Oily yellow spots, white growth under leaf
differential_diagnosis: Powdery mildew (white powder on upper surface, dry) vs Anthracnose

name: Panama wilt
symptoms: Yellowing, pseudostem splitting, vascular discoloration
differential_diagnosis: Waterlogging/root rot vs Moko (bacterial, fruit rot) vs Nematode damage

name: Sigatoka leaf spot
symptoms: Brown streaks, leaf spots, reduced photosynthesis

name: Anthracnose
symptoms: Dark sunken lesions on leaves, flowers, fruit
differential_diagnosis: Bacterial black spot (angular, raised) vs Powdery mildew

name: Powdery mildew
symptoms: White powdery growth on inflorescence
differential_diagnosis: Anthracnose (dark lesions, humid) vs Malformation (vegetative/floral distortion)

name: Citrus canker
symptoms: Corky raised lesions with yellow halo on leaves/fruit
management: Copper sprays, windbreaks, clean nursery stock

name: Little leaf
symptoms: Small narrow leaves, bushy stunted growth
differential_diagnosis: Viral mosaic (mottling) vs Nutrient deficiency

name: Bacterial wilt
symptoms: Wilting, vascular browning

name: Yellow vein mosaic
symptoms: Yellowing of veins, stunting, few fruits
differential_diagnosis: Leaf curl (thrips/whitefly) vs Iron chlorosis (no yellow veins)
